src/vendor/cisco/CISCO-ENTITY-ALARM-MIB.reason: The module uses Unsigned32 but imports it FROM CISCO-TC, which does not define it. Imported FROM SNMPv2-SMI instead, where it comes from.

src/vendor/cisco/CISCO-IPMCAST-MIB.reason: Imports igmpInterfaceEntry FROM IGMP-MIB, a superseded draft this repository has retired. RFC 2933 publishes the module as IGMP-STD-MIB.

src/vendor/cisco/CISCO-LWAPP-AP-MIB.reason: Uses CLDot11Band without importing it. Added to the IMPORTS from CISCO-LWAPP-TC-MIB, which is where the textual convention is defined.

src/vendor/cisco/CISCO-VISM-TRAPS-MIB.reason: Imports intSrvFlowStatus FROM INT-SERV-MIB, a module name that was never published -- RFC 2213 calls it INTEGRATED-SERVICES-MIB.

src/vendor/cisco/CISCO-VOICE-DIAL-CONTRO.reason: Imports intSrvFlowStatus FROM INT-SERV-MIB, a module name that was never published -- RFC 2213 calls it INTEGRATED-SERVICES-MIB.

cisco-mibs-v1.name: Cisco Systems
cisco-mibs-v1.note: The SMIv1 half of the same repository. A handful of the oldest Cisco modules were never reissued in SMIv2 and appear only here.

cisco-mibs-v2.name: Cisco Systems
cisco-mibs-v2.note: Cisco publishes its MIBs as a git repository rather than a release artefact, so a module is fetchable at a stable path and its history is public. Pinned to the default branch on purpose: a tag would make staleness undetectable, which is the thing this manifest exists to prevent.

net-snmp.name: Net-SNMP
net-snmp.note: The agent's own MIBs, taken from the branch the project releases from.

synology.name: Synology
synology.note: Synology ships every DSM MIB in one archive, revised in place. The archive holds several modules this repository has never carried.

taishin-vendor-mibs.name: taishin/vendor_mibs (third-party collection)
taishin-vendor-mibs.note: Not Brocade. A third-party collection, recorded because it is where this copy came from and that is worth more than nothing -- but --check against it detects the collection moving, not the vendor. Brocade's IP networking passed to Extreme Networks and its SAN business to Broadcom; neither serves this module at a stable public URL that has been found. Replace this entry if one is.

ubiquiti-airos.name: Ubiquiti
ubiquiti-airos.note: The airOS MIB archive. Covers the two general airOS modules only; the EdgeMAX, airFiber and UniFi modules are not published this way.
